record.question: On what ground did Arvind Kejriwal and his Councils of Ministers recently resign?
options: Failure to introduce Jan Lokpal Bill in the state Assemby
record.explanation: Answer C: Failure to introduce Jan Lokpal Bill in the state Assemby. Kejriwal and his Council of Ministers resigned on 14 February 2014 after they could not introduce the Janlokpal Bill in the Delhi Assembly. The Home Minister's contemporary parliamentary statement identifies that reason. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=103767. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
